prompts.background:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: Bullets of Fury ending cinematic environment plate.
Input image 1 is the existing damaged satellite dish composition and world reference. Regenerate it with substantially better cinematic 16/32-bit Neo Geo arcade pixel-art craftsmanship. This is a new environment plate, not a screenshot: NO lettering, subtitles, logos, interface, creature, spacecraft or characters.
FRAME FORMAT: one landscape 1920 x 1080 pixel image, even dimensions, approximately 16:9, consistent proportional perspective. Fixed camera environment, no montage or panels.
A gigantic ruined terrestrial communications dish at the coastal Fury installation after the war, sunset low at far left, near-black starry cobalt sky above, distant ocean/islands/city signals. Dish fills the right two thirds, rising from lower left to upper right. The communications dish has individually readable chrome/gunmetal tiles, cracked seams, twisted antenna ribs, scorched access hatches, suspended cables, a central antenna feed and subtle turquoise equipment windows. More legible than the reference: amber sunset rim light and cold moonlit steel highlights with rich shadow detail. The dish bowl surface and its central feed are clearly visible and empty, with usable room for a separate animated black symbiote to crawl along the bowl toward the feed.
High-quality hand-authored-looking pixel clusters, dense tactile metal detail, controlled 16/32-bit arcade shading, clean edge definition. Absolutely no photographic blur, no grain/noise, no watercolor. Give us the true HD arcade cinematic treatment while matching our existing world and silhouette. No baked special effects or glowing blob; those will animate as separate sprites. Preserve the atmospheric coastal setting.
prompts.detail:
Use case: stylized-concept, production cinematic environment.
Input image 1 is our new Bullets of Fury damaged communications dish. Create a MATCHING CLOSE-UP shot of its bowl and central antenna mechanism for the next beat of the same cinematic. Keep the same dusk lighting, amber sunset rim, cold steel shadows, turquoise electronics and architecture.
FRAME FORMAT: one wide 1920 x 1080 image, even dimensions, approximately 16:9. NO collage, no split panels, no lettering, no subtitles, no symbiote, no creatures, no characters, no ships.
The camera is low above the concave dish, looking along several large cracked titanium/chrome panels toward the broken central feed assembly near the right third. A broad readable bare metal crawl path crosses the middle foreground from lower left toward the raised receiver at upper right. Deep panel seams, bolts, exposed circuit conduit, fracture edges and glossy scorched steel surfaces; recognizable curved dish geometry and a section of the big mast/braces overhead. Keep the environment empty so our separate animated survivor can crawl through the shot. The left/back edge shows a thin sliver of the coastal night sky and amber horizon, not a flat industrial room.
True high-quality Neo Geo/16-32-bit arcade cinematic artwork, crisp controlled pixel clusters, substantial fine metal definition, legible large shapes, sharp clean contours, dense atmospheric but readable shading. No blur, no grain/noise, no generic photorealistic CGI. No baked sparks, electric effects or oil spill; these animate as separate sprites.
